spec.target: 8-period discounted contribution difference, fixed signal-reactive assistance versus action zero; 100 currency units per success and 12 per assistance
spec.assumptions: 2 latent states, binary signal and reward, action-invariant emission, conditionally independent signal/reward/transition, exogenous iid logging for identified case, interior probabilities and full ranks
spec.inference: Observed-information delta interval; no interval on indefinite/singular information, boundary fit or failed optimizer. Unconditional coverage counts such cases as failures. Single-trajectory bootstrap refits all environment parameters, fixed signal-to-action mapping.
spec.precision: 100 repeats gives MC SE .022 near .95; 60 repeats gives .028. Bootstrap quantiles from 79 fits are an explicitly coarse numerical comparison, not a coverage study.
spec.design: Frozen before results. Three-state misspecification and logger-aware recovery remain required scholarly comparisons; this experiment specifically measures rank weakness and omitted private logging.
